purpose_context: Before building the #692/#833 Life Lattice (the temporal graph that is the Executive Assistant's cognitive substrate), we run an isolated, zero-production-contact spike answering four make-or-break questions — chiefly whether temporal reasoning over a hand-seeded, life-shaped chain is genuinely useful. purpose_tldr: Throwaway, isolated spike to prove the Life Lattice's temporal reasoning genuinely pays off before committing to the graph build.
